# The timed budgets (make perf; docs/guide/performance.md, v2): the
# median of a benchmark on boardgen's board (-seed 1), on the reference
# machine (2 CPUs, Xeon 2.1 GHz, Linux), measured where it's quiet.
# make perf fails when a median is over its budget by more than the
# tolerance (15%). A budget moves down when the code gets faster; up only
# with a reason written here (a feature that must cost more), never to
# make a slower commit pass.
#
# name                    budget  why

# 20,000 issues: design.md, section 4's targets where they hold; where
# they don't yet, what holds now, the target named.
20k/cli/Ls                100ms   ls, view fresh: design.md's target
20k/cli/LsFields          100ms   ls with field terms: the terms narrow first, no more than ls
20k/cli/LsText            250ms   ls with free text, its index built (design.md: no target; v1 2.0 s)
20k/cli/LsFirst           4s      ls on a clone, no view (design.md's target 3 s: not met, the first build's cost)
20k/cli/LsTextFirst       7s      the first free-text ls builds the index (design.md's target 5 s: not met)
20k/cli/Show              30ms    show: design.md's target
20k/cli/Comment           50ms    a write: design.md's target
20k/cli/Set               50ms    a write: design.md's target
20k/cli/New               55ms    a write (design.md's target 50 ms: the counter and the view's insert)
20k/http/ListOpen         60ms    GET /api/issues, a first page: the list's budget
20k/http/ListColumn       60ms    a board's column, filtered and sorted
20k/http/ListAll          120ms   every issue at once (design.md's target 60 ms: not met, the JSON of 20,000)
20k/http/Facets           60ms    GET /api/labels, the filters panel's counts
20k/http/Snapshot         150ms   every issue at once for a page to keep (ADR 0023): ListAll's work, the kept build shared
20k/http/Thread           40ms    one issue's thread (design.md's target 10 ms: not met)
20k/http/EventsFanOut     70ms    a comment told to 50 pages
20k/http/WorkTeam         300ms   the Work page, every open issue (12,000), unpaged: 71 s before its rows were kept
20k/http/WorkTeamPage     300ms   the Work page's first page (limit=100): the task's budget
20k/http/WorkTeamFirst    3.5s    the Work page's first request, every open thread read (the server reads it in the background)

# 5,000 issues: a quarter of the work, so a regression that grows with
# the board shows on both.
5k/cli/Ls                 35ms    ls, view fresh
5k/cli/LsFields           30ms    ls with field terms
5k/cli/LsText             65ms    ls with free text, its index built
5k/cli/LsFirst            1s      ls on a clone, no view
5k/cli/LsTextFirst        2s      the first free-text ls builds the index
5k/cli/Show               15ms    show
5k/cli/Comment            30ms    a write
5k/cli/Set                40ms    a write
5k/cli/New                30ms    a write
5k/http/ListOpen          15ms    GET /api/issues, a first page
5k/http/ListColumn        20ms    a board's column
5k/http/ListAll           35ms    every issue at once
5k/http/Facets            20ms    the filters panel's counts
5k/http/Snapshot          40ms    every issue at once for a page to keep
5k/http/Thread            15ms    one issue's thread
5k/http/EventsFanOut      45ms    a comment told to 50 pages
5k/http/WorkTeam          60ms    the Work page, unpaged
5k/http/WorkTeamPage      60ms    the Work page's first page
5k/http/WorkTeamFirst     1s      the Work page's first request

# The pages on 5,000 issues (make perf-web): Lighthouse's mobile run, a
# slow 4G and a 4x slower CPU simulated, so a page's requests in a row
# cost ~150 ms each. The targets are Google's "good": LCP 2.5 s, FCP
# 1.8 s, TBT 200 ms. A desktop run is 0.8 s LCP.
5k/web/BoardLCP           3.2s    the board's page, its first issue's title painted (target 2.5 s; 2.8 s on a laptop, 2026-11-11)
5k/web/BoardFCP           2.3s    the board's first paint (target 1.8 s: its CSS blocks it, 48 KB)
5k/web/BoardTBT           200ms   the board's main thread blocked
5k/web/IssueLCP           3.5s    an issue's page, its panel over the board (target 2.5 s; 3.0 s on a laptop)
5k/web/IssueFCP           2.3s    an issue's first paint (target 1.8 s)
5k/web/IssueTBT           200ms   an issue's main thread blocked

# What a person does on a page (web/e2e/interactions.ts), timed in the
# page (Event Timing, and interaction.ts's act to the paint after its
# requests), in two setups on 5,000 issues:
#   Worst: the CPU 6x slower, slow 4G (150 ms a round trip); the targets
#          100 ms for what the page answers alone (an optimistic write,
#          what it shows), 200 ms for what needs the server's answer
#   Desk:  as it is; 50 and 60 ms (an act's paint waits a frame, ~16 ms)
# The laptop's medians on 2026-11-11 in each reason.
5k/web/InteractionOpenPaletteDesk     50ms    the command palette (40 ms)
5k/web/InteractionOpenPaletteWorst    100ms   (88 ms; its content made while closed: GbDialog warm)
5k/web/InteractionOpenShortcutsDesk   50ms    every shortcut (40 ms)
5k/web/InteractionOpenShortcutsWorst  100ms   (88 ms)
5k/web/InteractionApplyFilterDesk     50ms    a filter typed, answered from the board kept (32 ms)
5k/web/InteractionApplyFilterWorst    100ms   (72 ms; 470 ms when the server answered it)
5k/web/InteractionRenameIssueDesk     50ms    a title saved, as shown before its answer (16 ms)
5k/web/InteractionRenameIssueWorst    100ms   (40 ms)
5k/web/InteractionOpenIssueDesk       60ms    a card clicked to its panel, every read at once (40 ms)
5k/web/InteractionOpenIssueWorst      200ms   (152 ms: one round trip; read ahead on hover, less)
